description: The answer to a question asked with ask_support. The first call runs the question and can take a few minutes; a client that cuts tool calls sooner can leave it running until it fails as interrupted. Pass wait: false to read its state without running it. status is pending, running, answered, budget_exhausted or failed; report_reference is set when the agent filed a problem for the team.
name: get_support_answer
title: Get a support answer
